title: How A Stay-At-Home Dad’s Bagel Baking Hobby Turned Into A $46 Million Business
summary: Jeff’s Bagel Run, specializing in New York style bagels, expects to have 100 bagel shops open by the end of 2027, thanks to a deal with a Forbes 30 Under 30 alumnus.
